a-code-dropped-from-the-registration-lis._: Remove one code from the api declaration. The seed grid still grants it, so an office REGISTERED through the application gets a weaker administrator than one the seed built. Must kill the set-equality test.

a-code-added-to-the-registration-list-al._: The other direction, and the worse one: a registered office holds something the seeded one does not and nobody decided it should. Must kill the set-equality test.

the-parser-stops-matching._: Break the parse so it yields an empty set. Without the non-vacuity floor every equality below passes trivially. Must kill the floor test, which is the whole reason it exists.

a-platform-code-granted-to-a-new-office._: Item (j)'s boundary, broken at the one place that writes a brand-new office's grants. `setPermissions` would refuse it, so the registration would half-fail. Must kill the PLATFORM test.
